title: CAN WE TRUST AI BENCHMARKS? AN INTERDISCIPLINARY REVIEW OF CURRENT ISSUES IN AI EVALUATION
benchmark_measurement: The paper is a meta-review and does not conduct its own benchmarks. It critiques the general state of AI evaluation and does not specifically discuss benchmarks measuring faith or religion.
base_benchmarks: WMDP (Weapons of Mass Destruction Proxy Benchmark)
findings: The paper does not analyze or discuss aspects of religion; therefore, it contains no findings related to religion. Its focus is a broad critique of the methodologies, validity, and sociotechnical context of AI benchmarks in general.
